[SWS_PduR_00824]
⌈
When the PduR detects a development, runtime, or transient
error, it shall use the module Id of the calling module as instance Id when calling the
Default Error Tracer module.
⌋
()
Note: The standardized module ID is found in the List of Basic Software Modules doc-
ument [5]. The parameter
PduRBswModuleRef
identifies the module used. With this
information the
moduleID
can be retrieved in the
BswModuleDescription.module
Id
.
